descriptions.good: Feed ingredients appear uniform, clean, and free of visible fungal colonies or heat scorch.
descriptions.moldy: Surface exhibits white/grey fungal mycelium or spore aggregations posing mycotoxin risks.
descriptions.burnt: Excessive dark, charred, or burnt particles indicating heat degradation and nutrient loss.
descriptions.pecky: Signs of insect punctures, dark spots, or particulate contamination.
descriptions.scorched: Noticeable heat discoloration and irregular moisture patches.
descriptions.greenish: Immature or abnormally pigmented particles that may indicate irregular drying or chlorophyll retention.
